purpose: Original detailed deck and below-deck reconstruction for the existing ordinary POTC family and both paint variants.

stock_contract.claim: Existing pinned stock-derived identity and total count only; no game interior coordinates known.

method: Museum and primary-plan catalogue research supplies arrangement vocabulary. All metre dimensions, room positions and access clearances are authored to the preserved hull. Public source text is paraphrased; no museum image, plan tracing or proprietary texture is distributed.

sources.title: Royal Museums Greenwich: Ganymede (captured 1809), ZAZ3644
sources.kind: Primary Portsmouth Dockyard survey plan catalogue
sources.observed: The catalogue identifies the lower-deck plan of the captured French corvette Ganymede before fitting as a 24-gun sixth rate.
sources.application: A non-battery lower deck below the flush main gun deck, with aft accommodation and storage.
sources.limit: The analogue has a different rating and size. The ordinary POTC Corvette remains 32 guns with the original flush-deck silhouette.
sources.applies_to: A non-battery lower deck below the flush main gun deck, with aft accommodation and storage.

sources.application: Keep the working main deck and its single battery visually distinct from the enclosed berth deck.

sources.applies_to: Keep the working main deck and its single battery visually distinct from the enclosed berth deck.

decisions.basis: Flush main deck with one 32-gun battery, three square-rigged masts and no castles. Main hatch enters a continuous non-battery berth deck whose centered level door opens into the real cabin; framed provision hold remains below. This is an authored adaptation of the listed historical analogues to the unchanged game-family gun total.

decisions.feature: Physically separate lower levels and hold
decisions.basis: The authored hull contains distinct berth_lower and a framed hold. Numerical deck and floor baselines are fitted estimates; the source deck hierarchy supplies arrangement vocabulary rather than retail game coordinates.

decisions.feature: After cabin and unobstructed structural access
decisions.basis: The furnished after cabin has a real centered partition door opening from its own lower deck. The main hatch shaft reaches that level; no side stair crosses a cabin wall or opens into a sealed low quarterdeck space. Cabin dimensions and this access route are authored game-environment choices. The authored front partition is set aft of the unchanged mizzen so its complete centered doorway approach remains clear; this is a fitted spatial choice, not a coordinate taken from a historical plan.

coordinate_system.longitudinal: s_fraction of preserved deck length, positive forward
coordinate_system.absolute_plan: x_m across ship, y_m up, forward_z_m positive bow
coordinate_system.note: Vertical z_m fields follow the existing Blender builder convention; longitudinal at/from/to are fractions.
